text: 【周末要闻汇总】央行、证监会将于明天召开座谈会，研究推动支持资本市场工具使用；央行定调继续实施适度宽松的货币政策，保持流动性充裕；证监会表态全力稳市场稳预期，持续提升资本市场韧性和信心；五部门发布《加强消费基础设施建设 促进消费投资良性互动的指导意见》；国有某大行计划向中国国新和中国诚通各新增千亿级股票回购增持专项贷款额度；10月官方制造业PMI为49.3%；纳指跌近3%，费城半导体指数跌超7%，英特尔重挫逾28%；现货黄金失守3900美元关口，创一年新低。
text_en: [Weekend News Roundup] The PBOC and the CSRC will hold a symposium tomorrow to study ways to promote the use of tools supporting the capital market; the PBOC affirmed it will continue to implement a moderately loose monetary policy and maintain ample liquidity; the CSRC stated it will make every effort to stabilize the market and expectations and continuously enhance the resilience and confidence of the capital market; five government departments issued the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Consumer Infrastructure Construction and Promoting Benign Interaction Between Consumption and Investment; a major state-owned bank plans to add 100 billion yuan-level special loan quotas for stock buybacks and increased shareholdings to China Reform Holdings and China Chengtong each; the official October manufacturing PMI was 49.3%; the Nasdaq fell nearly 3%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped more than 7%, and Intel plunged more than 28%; spot gold fell below the $3,900 mark, hitting a one-year low.
